about: Real answers from OpenAI Chat Completions to the prompts in server/src/admin/network-translate.ts, with response_format json_schema. Each string is the assistant message content exactly as the model returned it, recorded 2026-11-09. gpt-5.6-terra is the deployment default and wrote a list that parses first time, from the vendors' published lists in the prompt. gpt-4o-mini is where the parse gate earns its keep: it copies a host name with an underscore, which the computer's parser refuses. Sent back, it once changed the name to a different host (fixedOnRetry, which the independent reading then names), and once wrote the same names again (neverParses).
